  |> set(key: "_field", value: "BMS (A)")

from(bucket: "live")

panels.title: 📱 Telefoane si aplicatie (cine cere date de la server)
Telefoane cu acces si versiunea aplicatiei
panels.description: Telefoanele care au cerut date de la API in ultimele 30 de zile, dupa model. Versiunea apare de la v3.38 (aplicatia o trimite in User-Agent); inainte se vede doar modelul, ca „veche (≤3.37)". Cereri/min: media pe ultimele 10 minute (aplicatia pe ecran ~70/min, in fundal doar alarma ~12-18/min, fara alarme 0). Sursa: masuratoarea app_client, scrisa o data pe minut de solar-api.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "app_client" and r._field == "requests")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({model: r.model, android: r.android, app_version: r.app_version, last_seen: r._time}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["last_seen"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "app_client" and r._field == "requests")
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({model: r.model, req_24h: r._value}))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "history")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "app_client" and r._field == "requests")
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({model: r.model, req_min: r._value / 10.0}))
  |> group()
